title: Jensen Huang Is Back: 3 Things That Change at Nvidia Now #Shorts
description:
Jensen Huang is back, but Nvidia has changed: a new National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee (chaired by director Suzanne Nora Johnson), Harvey C. Jones as the board's first-ever chair, interim CEO Colette Kress back to CFO, and from 1 Dec, interviews with three House committees.

Sources (checked 24 Nov 2026):
- NVIDIA 8-K, CEO transition (12 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm
- NVIDIA 8-K, Huang reinstated (23 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000090/nov23pressrelease.htm
- Anadolu (oversight committee): https://aa.com.tr/en/world/nvidia-sets-up-national-security-export-control-committee-after-huangs-departure/4127668
- AP via Boston Globe (1-2 Dec interviews): https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/11/17/business/nvidia-earning-surpass-expecations/

Allegations mentioned are reports, not proven facts. Our analysis is labelled as such. News, not financial advice.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (Google Flow) and animations; facts checked against the sources above. Independent channel, not affiliated with NVIDIA.
